summary.text:
Global equity markets are retreating, with the S&P 500 down 1.44% and the Nasdaq falling 1.56%, while the VIX jumped 7.37% to 26.37. European markets also softened, with the DAX losing 1.06%. Sentiment is weighed down by mounting legal exposure for Nvidia, whose shares fell 1.58%, and UnitedHealth sliding amid a government crackdown on Medicare Advantage fraud.

In currency markets, the US Dollar Index is steady at 103.874, with the British pound sliding 0.81% to 1.3098 and the euro dipping 0.11% to 1.0981. Commodities softened as gold dropped 1.65% to 3680.3 and Brent crude slipped 1.94% to 90.17, while Bitcoin fell 0.58% to 62624.8398.

Moving forward, market participants will monitor the European Union postponing its methane regulation over energy security, Amazon contesting a New York City delivery bill, and MoonPay pursuing a banking license for stablecoin operations.
